  SELECT * FROM store.daily_sales
  WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND date < DATE '2026-07-01'
),
oos_days AS (SELECT date FROM june_sales WHERE units_sold = 0),
aud AS (
  SELECT audit_ts::date AS d, status FROM store.shelf_audits
  WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND audit_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND audit_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01'
),
lost AS (
  SELECT o.date, f.forecast_units_per_day - s.units_sold AS lu, p.price_inr
  FROM oos_days o

  JOIN store.forecasts f ON f.date=o.date AND f.sku='ATTA-WW-5KG'

)
